---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for sql-switch
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem / motivation

What problem are you trying to solve? What's the use case, and why does the
current behavior fall short?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. If it touches the public API, sketch how a call would
look, since the surface is deliberately only what `src/database/index.ts`
re-exports.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches or workarounds you've thought about, and why they aren't
enough.

## Additional context

Anything else: which engine it matters for (SQLite, PostgreSQL, or both),
whether it affects the write collector or engine swap, links, or prior art.
